rows.label: tlk70000056_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Nii-chan and the Onee-chans...
Are you really going to fight?

rows.label: tlk70000056_05_msg0002
rows.name:
You'll come back soon, right?
You won't just disappear, will you?

rows.label: tlk70000056_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I've decided to become a Driver.
There's so much I want to ask Nii-chan
and the Onee-chans.

rows.label: tlk70000056_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Dad, Kei, and I will stay right here,
waiting for Nii-chan and the
Onee-chans.

rows.label: tlk70000056_05_msg0005
rows.name:
I don't want to say goodbye to
someone important ever again.
